title: Care
description: Ordered care instructions (label order: washing, bleaching, drying, ironing, professional_care). For a code in vocabularies/care.json a node returns the vocabulary's category, symbol and name; for another code what it was given, or null.

code.description: Care instruction code, ISO 3758 aligned (vocabularies/care.json), e.g. wash_30, do_not_bleach, tumble_dry_low, iron_low, dry_clean_p, do_not_dry_clean.

category.description: The ISO 3758 symbol group. null = unknown (a code outside the vocabulary).

symbol.description: The symbol code in GINETEX notation as fashion data pools exchange it (group digit, symbol, temperature: 1_C_40, 2_X, 3_C, 4_B, 5_P), so a consumer can reuse an existing pictogram mapping. null when there is none.

name.description: The name of the instruction per language, e.g. {"en": "Wash at 30 °C", "nl": "Wassen op 30 °C"}.

text.description: Extra text of the brand for this instruction, e.g. "Wash inside out".
